Photos.Caption: Bacon wrapped mushrooms. They cooked perfectly.
I like my grilled vegetables too!

Results.ReviewText:
Got this grill as a Christmas present a few weeks ago after my cheaper grill rusted out in less than a year. I learned my lesson, and here’s my advice: don’t expect that $250 4 burner grill from Home Depot to last you that long. Also don’t expect much customer service either. Do yourself a favor and go for a reputable company that’s bold enough to give you a ten year warranty on all parts. 

Let’s start with what’s good: It’s well-made. From the moment I picked up the box and realized how heavy this small two-burner grill is, I knew it was because it’s good quality. Assembly was a breeze, even with the funky 3D instructions from the app. Anyone comfortable with a screw driver and a hammer can put this together. A cordless drill/bit driver will make everything so much faster and easier. After you put it together just step back and look at it, it’s actually quite nice for an entry-level gas grill. It will not be that nice and shiny ever again so enjoy the moment. 

So how does it grill? Accurate burner control and even heat throughout the grilling surface are just about the two most important aspects of any grill. And this grill shines in both aspects. The rear of the grill is the hottest, and that’s expected since it has a connecting burner that goes across to feed the right side burner. That’s the spot you want to use if you want those nice grill marks on that steak. The burner regulators have 180 degrees of range, that’s important, especially if you come from a cheaper grill that has only 90 degrees from low to high. You’ll feel like a grill master from the first time you use it. Another very important aspect is flare-up control, nothing can ruin what you’re cooking more than uncontrolled flare-ups. I put it to its ultimate test when I covered just about every square inch of that grill with bacon-wrapped mushrooms. I was waiting for it, the moment when I had to turn off the grill because it’s practically catching on fire. That moment never came. It just cooked very controlled with very minimal flare-ups, and the result was very juicy mushrooms with crispy bacon on the outside. It was quite the hit when I entertained for new year’s Eve. 

The only bad thing I can think of is that it doesn’t get as hot as I would like. 10 minutes with both burners on high and the lid down, will barely get the grill to 550 degrees F. But it will get hot enough to make grill marks on a steak, you just have to be patient. Also it’s nice that one of the side shelves collapses, but it would be even nicer if both collapsed. Also the Price at around $375 is a bit steep, even for this quality. 

Overall I’ll recommend this grill to just about anyone. It’s affordable, and it performs great.
Results.Title: Great small grill

This Spirit II is convenient for the two of us.  We now fire it up for a couple of burgers, a couple of small chicken breasts, or some Italian sausages.  Often, we use only the one burner for the two of us.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I have been buying gas grills since the 60's.  I liked them because they are handy.  I think I have used every brand out there.  With each brand there was a learning curve.  Where is the hottest area.  I bought my first Weber about 10 years ago.  It was a Spirit III,  From the first time I used it to it's dying day it had to most even heat of any grill I have ever used.   I wish I would of bought one sooner but I figured the price was too high and not really worth the money,  Was I wrong. Thee area probably the best bang for the buck grill made.  It was the longest lasting grill I ever owned.  Finally it did give up.  Not the cooking part but the housing,  it rusted away the cooking area was still working fine.  Of course I bought another grill.  This time the Spirit.  The kids are grown so it is just me and management and I didn't need any thing larger.  I am looking forward to this grill to last the rest of my life.  I have it in my outdoor man cave along with a pellet smoker.  Who needs anything else. Now I see Weber is coming out with one of those also,.  Too bad I already have one.
Thanks Weber
Results.Title: The best grill ever made

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Had several months now. Cooks great. Love the cast iron grill plates. Heat well and is solid. I had some issues with folding table wing. Wanted to drop on me and fell off the hinge twice. Had to flex the table wings a bit to make snug. Otherwise I would certainly recommend.
Results.Title: Great grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
